summary: Validated the 2FA login bug fix on /connexion (LoginPage.jsx). Both backend and frontend flows work end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (login challenge w/o 2FA → session; wrong password → 401; enable email 2FA → persisted; login challenge w/ 2FA → challenge_token; wrong code → 400 'Code de vérification invalide'; correct code → access_token + cookies). Frontend E2E on preview: /connexion → Admin tile → email+password submit now opens the 2FA panel (ShieldCheck icon + 'code envoyé à admin@cmgeorges.com' message + 6-digit input + 'Vérifier et se connecter' + '← Changer de compte'). Wrong code (000000) stays on 2FA form with toast error. Injected known code → 'Connexion réussie!' toast + redirect to /admin/dashboard. Previous bug (toast error, no 2FA UI) is fully resolved — /connexion now uses authApi.loginChallenge instead of legacy /auth/login.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.jsx uses authApi.loginChallenge correctly; both branches (challenge_required true/false) handled. State cleanup on 'Changer de compte' is correct.

Legacy POST /api/v1/auth/login (server.py:888-928) still exists for backward compat; consider deprecating once all clients migrate to /login/challenge to avoid future bugs where callers forget to switch.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily enabled email 2FA for admin + injected a known 2FA code (321987) in email_2fa_codes. Teardown executed: two_factor_enabled=false, two_factor_method=null. DB restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 2FA login bug on /connexion is confirmed FIXED. Regression suite at backend/tests/test_login_2fa_flow.py can be reused — it auto-resets admin 2FA state in module teardown. Playwright script uses subprocess to venv python with bcrypt/pymongo to inject known 2FA codes.
